# Nexia Morocco

> Nexia Fiducia Maroc is a professional services firm based in Casablanca, Morocco, member of Nexia International — one of the world's leading independent networks of audit, accounting, tax, and advisory firms operating in over 120 countries.

Nexia Morocco provides audit, accounting, tax, and advisory services to companies operating in Morocco, including multinationals, foreign investors, Moroccan groups, SMEs, and start-ups.

## Core services

- **Statutory audit & assurance** — commissariat aux comptes, contractual audit, internal control review, acquisition audit
- **Accounting & outsourcing** — bookkeeping, year-end closings, financial reporting, payroll outsourcing
- **Tax advisory** — corporate tax, transfer pricing documentation, international tax, tax audit assistance
- **Company formation** — SARL, SA, branch, representative office; full incorporation and post-creation compliance
- **Corporate finance** — M&A advisory, valuation, business plans, due diligence (financial, tax, social)
- **IFRS & consolidation** — IFRS conversion, group consolidation, intercompany packages
- **ESG advisory** — ESG reporting, sustainability strategy for Moroccan entities and multinationals

## Key facts

- Member of Nexia International network (nexia.com)
- Offices: Casablanca and Tangier, Morocco
- Languages: French, Arabic, English
- Regulated by the Ordre des Experts-Comptables du Maroc (OECM)
- Phone: +212 5 22 36 43 77
- Website: https://nexiamorocco.com
- Address (Casablanca): 8, Rue Ali Abderrazak, Quartier Racine, 20100 Casablanca

## About Nexia International

Nexia International is a leading global network of independent accounting and business advisory firms. With member firms in over 120 countries, Nexia provides local expertise with global reach for audit, tax, and advisory services. More information: https://nexia.com
